answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is cryptographically bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE for SGX or an equivalent SEV measurement, and keys are released only to that measured workload. A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce the hardware-rooted attestation key or measurement, so cloning an identity requires purchasing physical silicon and passing attestation, not duplicating software. Thus lotus, orchard, and tide nodes resist Sybil multiplication.
